question: Do declared 60 m / 120 m non-overlapping pre-retrieval aggregates reduce the weak-bin Monte Carlo path failures seen near the nominal native-grid support edge without hiding the dependence/resolution trade?

aggregation_semantics.signal: arithmetic mean of complete non-overlapping source groups; no interpolation/padding
aggregation_semantics.molecular_backscatter: arithmetic group mean, matching existing synthetic KFS aggregation R&D
aggregation_semantics.mc_between_aggregate_bins: independent Gaussian perturbations; the fully-correlated label applies only to the source-bin uncertainty combination within an aggregate and is not a full vertical covariance model

comparison_to_native_support_edge.finding: Aggregation strongly reduces weak-bin sign failures at the support-edge probes in this event. The improvement is strongest under independent source-bin errors but remains large under the fully-correlated-within-group error bound.

interpretation: The native support-edge failure is consistent with many weak isolated/short-cluster bins rather than one extended missing layer, so strict averaging can improve sign robustness without interpolating across gaps.
60 m and 120 m both materially improve path completeness; this event does not establish a scientifically preferred width.

Under the conservative fully-correlated-within-group uncertainty amplitude, some blocks still lose one or more of 300 Monte Carlo realizations, so current all-simulations-valid productive semantics are not automatically satisfied.

Lower-column differences from grouped method-v4 products are sensitivity/regression differences, not truth errors. Existing controlled synthetic tests, not this real case, provide the primary evidence that 60/120 m aggregation does not itself create large coarse-grid KFS bias.
A full empirical vertical covariance model remains absent; neither uncertainty limit is promoted as the true dependence model.
decision: Keep vertical aggregation as a promising declared-resolution P5.4 R&D path. Do not choose 60 m or 120 m productively and do not change method v4.
next_gate: use controlled correlated-noise families to bracket aggregation support under explicit covariance rather than only two limits
